34:t_033:8.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I don't care what happens to me! I don't care what happens to the world!」

34:t_033:10.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I'll save her, no matter what!!」

34:t_033:13.en:
$$ミサト$$
「Not for anyone else! For your own wish!!」

34:t_034:1.en:
$$マヤ$$
「No way...! The shape-control limiter is gone! Unable to analyze!」

34:t_034:2.en:
$$リツコ$$
「The EVA we kept within the bounds of humanity is regaining its true form.」

34:t_034:3.en:
$$リツコ$$
「Breaking the curse humans placed on it, it is becoming a being beyond humanity, close to a god.」

34:t_034:4.en:
$$リツコ$$
「Weaving together heaven, earth, and all things, it's transforming itself into a condensed mass of energy amid the great surge of complementarity...」

34:t_034:5.en:
$$リツコ$$
「To purely grant people's wishes... For that reason alone...!」

34:t_036:2.en:
$$リツコ$$
「It's useless. Even if you try to stop this, there's no way to interfere with the EVA as it is now.」

34:t_037:0.en:

34:t_037:1.en:
$$冬月$$
「As expected, those two have achieved Unit-01's awakening.」

34:t_037:2.en:

「Yes. We are very close now to reaching our plan.」

34:t_037:5.en:
$n

34:t_037:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is he... becoming something other than human...!?」

34:t_038:0.en:
$$マリ$$

34:t_039:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Ngh...! It's dangerous to stay here!」

34:t_040:0.en:
$$キャシー$$

34:t_040:1.en:
$$ボビー$$

34:t_040:2.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$

34:t_040:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But this sensation...! I've experienced something similar before!」

34:t_040:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「This is... could it be...!」

34:t_040:5.en:
$$リツコ$$
「The birth of a new life that transcends the laws of this world. As the price, the old life perishes.」

34:t_040:7.en:
$$リツコ$$
「Yes, the continuation of $$セカンドインパクト$$... $$サードインパクト$$ is beginning. The world is going to end...」

34:t_042:1.en:
???
「Now, the time of our promise has come.」

34:t_042:2.en:
$$カヲル$$
「$$碇シンジ$$... This time, I'll make sure that you, at least, are happy.」

34:t_043:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Tch...! This ship can't do any more than this!」

34:t_043:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「$c...! Don't think this is my true strength!」

34:t_044:0.en:
$$オットー$$
「I can't believe that is just a sore loser talking...」

34:t_044:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「What did $$サイデリアル$$ force a breakthrough and come all the way here for...」

34:t_045:0.en:
$$マヤ$$
「One minute until Unit-01 reaches its operational limit!」

34:t_045:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「We will save $$綾波$$ within this one minute!」

34:t_047:0.en:
$$マヤ$$
「Unit-01 is at its operational limit!」

34:t_047:1.en:
$$ミサト$$
「Is this as far as it goes...!?」

$$シンジ$$
「Move... move... move! Move, damn it!」

34:t_047:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
「If I can't move, $$綾波$$ will...!!」

34:t_048:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Annihilation of the $$新地球皇国$$ forces confirmed!」

34:t_048:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「All that's left is to rescue $$レイ#pt394$$!」

34:t_101:1.en:
